adaptations: Repository, service name and port are installer arguments; no product-specific host path.
GitHub deployment variables and concurrency group are repository-scoped.
Application packaging, compatibility checks and manual review policy are retained.
Latest-only concurrency, obsolete-request skips and cancellation rollback added with real SIGINT/SIGTERM regression tests.
Validation extracts the complete exact commit while public releases remain app-only; failures retain output; controller-only upgrades preserve existing services and data with version hashes.
